name: Husband
overview: Scripture presents the role of a husband as one of deep relational unity and love, beginning with the creation account where a man leaves his parents to unite with his wife, becoming 'one flesh' (Genesis 2:23-24). The example of Isaac, who loved Rebekah and brought her into his mother Sarah's tent, illustrates the comfort and affection integral to husbandly love (Genesis 24:67). Additionally, the instructions given through Moses emphasize the husband's role in matters of faithfulness and righteousness within marriage (Numbers 5:11-13), underscoring the seriousness of marital commitment and the husband's responsibility in upholding it.
